project.name: basis
project.description: Basis — Jetpack Compose design system with declarative intent, Oklch color science, and documentation site.

nodes.name: BasisTheme
nodes.summary: Accessor object for reading theme values inside a `BasisTheme` block. Every property calls [requireAmbient] internally, so reading any value outside a `BasisTheme` block throws [IllegalStateException] immediately with a descriptive message. ```kotlin val surfaceColor = BasisTheme.colors.surface.default  // Compose Color val bodyStyle   = BasisTheme.typography.content.level2 // TextStyle ```

nodes.name: BasisTheme
nodes.summary: Convenience overload that runs [resolve] on [intent], selects the tree for [useDarkTheme], and provides the ambient. This overload is intended for simple use cases. When the caller manages a resolved pair (e.g. to access the [ResolutionReport] independently), use the primary overload with [ResolvedTheme]. @param intent Design intent; the empty intent yields a coherent default theme. @param useDarkTheme Whether to select the dark tree. @param fontRegistry Registry mapping font references to Compose font families. Defaults to [FontFamilyRegistry.Default]. @param content Composable subtree under the theme ambient.

nodes.name: requireAmbient
nodes.summary: Returns the current [BasisThemeAmbient] or throws [IllegalStateException] when called outside a `BasisTheme` block. Every public Basis component calls this (directly or through [BasisTheme] accessors) so the error surfaces at the first composable read, not at a silent default.

nodes.name: BasisThemeAmbient
nodes.summary: Resolved theme values held in the composition ambient. Both the OKLCH source-of-truth [theme] and the Compose-ready accessor trees are carried so components read through typed accessors while advanced consumers can reach raw tokens via [BasisTheme.current]. @property theme OKLCH source-of-truth retained for diagnostics and advanced access. @property colors Compose-ready color locals converted at the theme entry boundary. @property typography Compose-ready typography locals with [TextStyle] per type role. @property spacing Spacing ladder, passed through unchanged. @property radius Corner radius ladder, passed through unchanged. @property depth Elevation and shadow ladder, passed through unchanged. @property size Icon, avatar, control, and dot size ladders. @property motion Semantic motion purpose specs. @property componentPatches Per-component overrides from [io.github.alph_a07.basis.theme.intent.ControlIntent]. @property report Optional public diagnostics; present when the host chose to pass the report through. Components must not depend on its presence.

nodes.name: DpConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Unit tests for [DpValue] and Compose [androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp] bidirectional conversion.

nodes.name: BasisThemeTest
nodes.summary: Instrumentation smoke tests for `BasisTheme` ambient enforcement and mode selection.

nodes.name: DepthConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Unit tests for [DepthSpec] to Compose elevation and shadow mapping.

nodes.name: toBasisTypographyLocals
nodes.summary: Converts [TypographyTokens] into [BasisTypographyLocals] using the provided family registry and resolved [ColorTokens]. Font families are resolved through [registry]; an unregistered [FontFamilyRef.Custom] key fails fast at theme construction time. @param colors OKLCH source tree for color dereference. @param registry Registry mapping [FontFamilyRef] to a Compose font family. @return Populated typography locals tree.

nodes.name: toTextStyle
nodes.summary: Maps a single [TypeRole] composite to a Compose [TextStyle] using preconverted [BasisColorLocals] and [FontFamilyRegistry]. @param colors Preconverted Compose color locals. @param registry Registry mapping font references to Compose font families. @return Mapped [TextStyle].

nodes.name: TypographyConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Unit tests for [TypeRole] to Compose [androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle] bridging.

nodes.name: toColor
nodes.summary: Converts an [Oklch] token into a Compose [Color]. This is the single conversion choke point in `basis-components`; no other code path should construct Compose [Color] values from theme data. Color-space mathematics and transfer functions are delegated to `basis-theme` via [ColorSpec.Argb]. @return The equivalent Compose [Color].

nodes.name: toArgb
nodes.summary: Converts an [Oklch] token into a 32-bit ARGB color integer. @return Packed ARGB integer representation in `0xAARRGGBB` channel layout.

nodes.name: ColorConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Unit tests for OKLCH to Compose [Color] bridging and [BasisColorLocals] conversion.

nodes.name: toFiniteAnimationSpec
nodes.summary: Maps a [MotionSpec] to a Compose [FiniteAnimationSpec]. [EasingKind.Spring] produces a [spring] spec using the [MotionSpec.spring] parameters; all other easing families produce a [tween] with the corresponding Compose easing curve. When spring params are absent on a Spring-eased spec, default spring values are used. @param T The type of value being animated. @return Mapped finite animation specification.

nodes.name: toAnimationSpec
nodes.summary: Maps a [MotionSpec] to a Compose [AnimationSpec]. Provided as a convenience for motion purposes (e.g. [MotionTokens.emphasis]) that may use spring animation with unbounded oscillation. Components should prefer the typed [FiniteAnimationSpec] overload when possible. @param T The type of value being animated. @return Mapped animation specification.

nodes.name: MotionConversionsTest
nodes.summary: Unit tests for [MotionSpec] to Compose animation spec bridging.

nodes.name: toElevationDp
nodes.summary: Extracts the elevation from this [DepthSpec] as a Compose [Dp]. @return Elevation in [Dp].

nodes.name: toShadowColor
nodes.summary: Computes a shadow [Color] derived from [baseColor] scaled by [DepthSpec.shadowAlpha]. @param baseColor Base color to tint the shadow with, defaults to black. @return Shadow color with modulated alpha.

tour.title: Project Overview & Architectural Conventions
tour.description: Explore AGENTS.md and settings.gradle.kts to understand the multi-module architecture (basis-theme, basis-components, basis-lint, demo-app, docs), Kotlin standards, and public Basis prefix rules.

tour.title: Declarative Theme Intent
tour.description: Inspect BasisIntent and control models representing user-provided brand colors, mood, fonts, and granular scalar overrides.

tour.title: Deterministic Theme Resolution Engine
tour.description: Follow the resolve() pipeline in ResolutionPipeline.kt, ThemeDraft.kt, and stage processors (BaseStage, DeriveStage, ControlStage, EnforceStage).

tour.title: Color Science: Oklch Conversion & Gamut Mapping
tour.description: Understand perceptual color calculations, Oklch transformations, and contrast repair algorithms enforcing accessible, vibrant palettes.

tour.title: Design Tokens & Foundations
tour.description: Examine immutable token wrappers like DpValue, SpValue and the complete ResolvedTheme tree carrying color, motion, depth, radius, size, spacing, and typography tokens.

tour.title: Jetpack Compose Integration: BasisTheme, Modifiers & Ambients
tour.description: Inspect BasisTheme composable, LocalBasisTheme composition local, and foundation modifiers bridging resolved design tokens into idiomatic Jetpack Compose styling.

tour.title: Documentation Platform & Interactive Site
tour.description: Explore the Astro documentation site, schema validation, MDX guides, and live theme preview capabilities.

tour.title: Custom Lint Rules & Detekt Enforcement
tour.description: Explore Basis custom lint detectors ensuring proper font size usage (SpOnlyFontSizeDetector) and registry definitions.

tour.title: Pipeline Verification Test Suite
tour.description: Check the ResolvePipelineTest and unit test suites validating theme resolution, token conversions, and constraint assertions.

tour.title: Build Configuration & Convention Plugins
tour.description: Examine root build.gradle.kts and detekt.yml configuring strict zero-warning compilation and convention plugins across modules.
